## Added

- Claude now shows your subscription tier, such as "Max 5x", in the same place Codex shows its plan.
- A new **Faster direct usage check** option under **Settings → Providers → Claude** reads your limits straight from Anthropic's usage service using your Claude Code sign-in. It is off by default, and UsageDeck explains the risk and asks you to confirm before turning it on, because Anthropic does not document or officially support this for other apps.

## Changed

- Claude usage is now read from the Claude Code usage screen by default, so sign-in stays entirely with Claude Code. Claude refreshes take several seconds longer than in 0.7.6. If you prefer the previous speed, turn on **Faster direct usage check** after reading its warning.

## Fixes

- Claude no longer fails with "Claude opened, but its usage panel could not be read" when Claude Code asks whether to trust UsageDeck's folder. UsageDeck now answers that one-time prompt for its own empty folder only, and shows a clear message if it cannot.
